description: Lyric pronunciation hardening: patterns that caused real engine misfires on Suno v6-mini, MiniMax 3.0, and Google Flow/Lyria 3.5, and how to write around them. Loaded into the music prompt generator's system prompt.

per_engine.happyshrimp_10: No pronunciation data yet — run the first generations with hardened lyrics and record misfires here.
per_engine.lyria_35: Pronounces worse than Suno v6-mini: simplify 11+ letter words, and always test lyric pacing on v6-mini before spending a Flow run.
per_engine.minimax_30: Handles dense lyrics better than Flow, but keep section tags to the official 14-tag vocabulary so structure survives.
per_engine.suno_v6: v6-mini pronounces cleanest — test lyric pacing there first, then run the keeper on v6 flagship.

rules.evidence: Flow HITL V2: 'A.C.' flagged in review; 'The AC' without periods sang cleanly.
rules.rule: Never write letter-period abbreviations (A.C., U.S.A.) — engines read them letter-by-letter or stumble. Write AC, USA.

rules.evidence: ALL-CAPS chant lines were delivered shouted or mispronounced on test renders.
rules.rule: Avoid ALL-CAPS lyric lines — they get shouted or mispronounced. Use mixed case; put delivery direction in [bracketed] section tags.

rules.evidence: Flow HITL V2 at ~140 BPM: the 'conversational drawl' vocal direction produced inaccurate word pronunciation across the vocal.
rules.rule: Do not direct 'conversational drawl' or similar loose vocal styles — they trade pronunciation accuracy for vibe. Prefer 'clear, rhythmic delivery' and put attitude in the Style field.

rules.evidence: Suno transcript: 'couch caught me like it missed me all day long' was heard as 'couch cut me like it, it's me all day long'; 'every ache' was heard as 'every eight'.
rules.rule: Watch consonant clusters across word boundaries ('couch caught me', 'every ache') — engines merge them into other words. Reword or respell the fragile line.

rules.evidence: Flow HITL V2: dense near-continuous vocals at ~140 BPM slurred; sparser sections stayed intelligible.
rules.rule: At ~135+ BPM keep lines breathable: dense near-continuous vocals slur. Add rests, breaks, and ad-lib space between phrases.

rules.evidence: Established Suno v6 practice: sustains on closed vowels ('love') collapse; open vowels hold.
rules.rule: Spell sustains into open vowels (lo-o-ove, staaay) once or twice per section; hyphenate staccato phrasing (do-not-call-me-back).

title: Lyric pronunciation hardening guide
